schema: phase3-reference-v1; arrays entries use raw npz key names; dtype/shape; sha256 = sha256 of np.ascontiguousarray(a).tobytes(order='C'); canonical PyTorch layouts (NCHW images, conv (out,in,kh,kw), linear (out,in))
bundle_hash_definition: sha256 over concat of per-array raw C-order bytes in manifest order
bundle_array_hash_definition: sha256 over concat of per-array raw C-order bytes in bundle order

schedule.rule: eta_t = eta_max * t / W for t <= W; cosine from eta_max to 0 for W < t <= T

model.name: Tiny ImageNet ResNet-18, small-image stem, GroupNorm-32
